parameters.query: SELECT r.id, r.title, r.description, r.excerpt, r.resource_type, r.category, r.subcategory, r.tags, r.is_public, r.target_roles, r.target_departments, r.target_employees, r.published_at, r.external_url, r.file_path, u.full_name as author_name FROM public.resources r LEFT JOIN public.users u ON r.author_id = u.id WHERE r.id = '{{ $json.resourceId }}' AND r.status = 'published' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1;

WITH targeted_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.email, u.full_name, u.role
  FROM public.users u
  WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND u.status = 'active'
    AND (
      -- Public resources: all users
      '{{ $json.is_public }}' = 'true' OR
      -- Role targeting: user's role matches
      (cardinality(ARRAY[{{ $json.target_roles }}]::user_role[]) = 0 OR u.role = ANY(ARRAY[{{ $json.target_roles }}]::user_role[])) OR
      -- Department targeting: user's department matches
      (cardinality(ARRAY[{{ $json.target_departments }}]::uuid[]) = 0 OR u.department_id = ANY(ARRAY[{{ $json.target_departments }}]::uuid[])) OR
      -- Employee targeting: user is specifically targeted
      (cardinality(ARRAY[{{ $json.target_employees }}]::uuid[]) = 0 OR u.id = ANY(ARRAY[{{ $json.target_employees }}]::uuid[]))
    )
)
SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'email', email, 'full_name', full_name, 'role', role)) as users FROM targeted_users;
